articles.title: Belgian cybersecurity startup Aikido hits unicorn status with new funding round
articles.mainIdea: Belgian cybersecurity startup Aikido hits unicorn status with new funding round
articles.summary: Reuters: Belgian cybersecurity startup Aikido hits unicorn status with new funding round. STOCKHOLM, Jan 14 - Belgium's Aikido Security has raised $60 million from investors led ​by tech-focused private equity firm DST Global ‌at a valuation of $1 billion, the cybersecurity startup said on ‌Wednesday, making it among Europe's first new unicorns of 2026. Founded in 2022, Aikido's security software helps developers detect and address risk automatically. It counts mobile app ⁠and game developer ‌Niantic, fintech Revolut and music streaming platform SoundCloud among its customers. Related tickers mentioned: META.

articles.mainIdea: Tesla Rival Xpeng Hires Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan To Prepare Hong Kong Listing For Aeroht: Report
articles.summary: Benzinga: Tesla Rival Xpeng Hires Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan To Prepare Hong Kong Listing For Aeroht: Report. Xpeng Inc. (NYSE:XPEV) has reportedly hired banks to help set up the automaker's flying car unit, Aeroht's Hong Kong public listing. Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan Hired The Chinese automaker has sought the services of Morgan Stanley, as well as JPMorgan & Chase Co., to prepare for the possible IPO, Bloomberg reported on Monday, citing anonymous sources familiar with the matter.
